question: The total surface area of a solid metallic hemisphere is 462 cm². This is melted and moulded into a right circular cone. If the radius of the base of the cone is the same as that of the hemisphere, then its height is: (use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

The total surface area of a solid metallic hemisphere is 462 cm2.

Hemisphere is melted into a right circular cone

The radius of the base of the cone is the same as that of the hemisphere

**Formula Used:**

The Surface area of the Hemisphere = 3pi r²

The volume of the hemisphere = (2)/(3)pi r³

The volume of cone=(1)/(3)pi r²h

**Calculations:**

⇒ The Surface area of the Hemisphere = 3pi r²

⇒ 462=3times (22)/(7)times r²

⇒ r² = 7 x 7

⇒ r = 7 cm

⇒ The radius of the cone = 7 cm

As Hemisphere is melted into a right circular cone, then

⇒ The volume of the Hemisphere = Volume of a cone

⇒ (2)/(3)pi r³= (1)/(3)pi r²h

⇒ 2r = h

⇒ h = 2 x 7 = 14 cm

⇒ **Hence, The height of the cone is 14 cm.**
